clue.text: Stick to external veto

indicators.note: external says the word for veto sits outside the word to, wrapping it

parts.note: to ban something is to veto it
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone is told to stick to an outside veto on a decision.
explanation.definitionFit: A baton is a short stick, such as a conductor's or relay runner's.

clue.text: Ring again to cancel

definitions.meaning: to peal bells a second time

explanation.surface: Phoning someone back just to call the whole thing off.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as RE-PEAL it means to sound bells again; as one word it means revoke a law.

clue.text: Decent painting turns up in an exhibition

indicators.note: in places the turned piece inside the word for exhibition

parts.note: an exhibition or spectacle is a sight

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up reads the word for painting from bottom to top

parts.note: painting is art

explanation.surface: A respectable picture appears at a gallery show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns up' reverses ART to TRA, which goes 'in' SIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: Straight can mean honest and decent, as in a straight dealer.

clue.text: Nimbleness of soldier in Italy on manoeuvres

indicators.note: troops on manoeuvres move about, so these letters are moved around

parts.note: GI is an American soldier
taken as written

explanation.surface: Agility shown by a soldier on military exercises in Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Agility and nimbleness are synonyms for quickness of movement.

clue.text: Italian city girl

definitions.meaning: a girl's name, as in Nightingale

explanation.surface: A young woman from a city in Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Florence is the Tuscan city and also a female first name.

clue.text: Let client change mind

indicators.note: change tells us to alter the order of these letters

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Allow a customer to have a change of heart.
explanation.definitionFit: Intellect is the reasoning faculty, the mind.

clue.text: A tear in a printed sheet indicates there's extraction

indicators.note: in places A and the word for tear inside the word for printed sheet

parts.note: a page is a printed sheet
a rent is a tear or rip

explanation.surface: A rip in a document is said to reveal something being pulled out.
explanation.definitionFit: Extraction means descent or origin, as in 'of Irish extraction', which is parentage.

clue.text: Straight to the point? But there is no point!

definitions.meaning: lacking a sharp edge or tip

explanation.surface: Being direct, though really there is nothing sharp about it.
explanation.definitionFit: Blunt means outspoken and also not sharp.

clue.text: It can give one airs, Indian fashion

definitions.text: It can give one airs, Indian fashion

indicators.note: rearranging in the Indian manner signals that these letters are reshaped

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A garment that lets the wearer put on airs, as worn in India.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Indian fashion' rearranges AIRS; the whole clue also describes the garment.
explanation.definitionFit: A sari is a draped garment worn by Indian women that can lend elegance.

clue.text: Joint vote cast in Irish parliament

indicators.note: in places the shuffled letters inside the Irish parliament

parts.note: the Dail is the lower house of the Irish parliament

indicators.note: cast suggests the letters are thrown into a new shape

explanation.surface: A combined vote is held in the Irish parliament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cast' rearranges VOTE to OVET, placed 'in' DAIL.
explanation.definitionFit: A dovetail is an interlocking woodworking joint.

clue.text: Something like a rush on silver is accepted

indicators.note: on means the plant word comes after the silver symbol

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
a reed is a plant similar to a rush

explanation.surface: A sudden run on silver is welcomed by the market.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rush' looks like a surge of buying but is the waterside plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Agreed means consented to or accepted.

clue.text: Garden pest pellet

definitions.meaning: a bullet or piece of shot

explanation.surface: Shooting a pellet at the creature eating the lettuces.
explanation.definitionFit: A slug is both a shell-less garden mollusc and a bullet.

clue.text: Musical figure

definitions.meaning: a percussion instrument in the orchestra

explanation.surface: A figure in a musical score.
explanation.definitionFit: A triangle is a percussion instrument and a three-sided shape.

clue.text: Acrobatic feat by bear going after applause

indicators.note: going after means the word for bear follows the word for applause

parts.note: giving someone a hand means applauding
to stand something is to bear it

explanation.surface: A performing bear does a trick after the audience claps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bear' is the verb meaning tolerate, not the animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A handstand is a gymnastic balance on the hands, an acrobatic feat.

clue.text: Accountants take care in partnership

parts.note: CA is a chartered accountant
not giving two hoots means not caring at all, so hoots stands for care

explanation.surface: Accountants are careful when entering a business partnership.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in cahoots' is the idiom, so 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Cahoots means collusion or partnership, used in the phrase 'in cahoots'.

clue.text: Machinist's work-rate poor

indicators.note: work as a verb tells us to knead these letters into a new form

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A factory worker's output is disappointing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'work-rate' looks like one compound noun, but 'work' is the anagram signal acting on the next two words.
explanation.definitionFit: An operator is someone who runs a machine, a machinist.

clue.text: Discipline gained since conversion to church

indicators.note: conversion changes the arrangement of these letters

parts.note: taken as written
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Someone found religious discipline after converting to the church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'conversion' rearranges SINCE to SCIEN, then CE is added.
explanation.definitionFit: A science is a branch of knowledge, a discipline.

clue.text: Factory shutdowns designed to cure loss

indicators.note: designed suggests the letters are arranged to a new plan

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Closing factories was meant to stem losses.
explanation.definitionFit: Closures are shutting downs, as of factories.

clue.text: Putting on a show in Old Street!

parts.note: ageing, or aging, means growing old

explanation.surface: A performance being put on in an old street.
explanation.definitionFit: Staging a play means putting it on as a show.

clue.text: Ardent, he may be following a cause

indicators.note: may be signals the letters could become something else

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: An eager man may well be a supporter of some movement.
explanation.definitionFit: Adherent describes someone sticking to and supporting a cause.

clue.text: It's not difficult to name a novel midshipman

definitions.meaning: Mr Midshipman ... is an 1836 novel by Frederick Marryat

explanation.surface: Naming the hero of a sea story is no hard task.
explanation.definitionFit: Easy means simple, and is the surname of Marryat's fictional midshipman.

clue.text: King of Mercia is of some note

parts.note: taken as written
fa is a note in the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: An Anglo-Saxon king of some musical renown.
explanation.walkthrough: Offa ruled the Anglo-Saxon kingdom of Mercia and built Offa's Dyke.
explanation.definitionFit: Offa was the eighth-century ruler of Mercia in central England.

clue.text: Made of iron, this strange object of worship

parts.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron

indicators.note: strange suggests the letters are made odd by rearranging

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: An odd iron idol that people worship.
explanation.definitionFit: A fetish is an object revered for supposed magical powers.

clue.text: Reversible conviction?

indicators.note: reversible says the word reads the same in both directions

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A belief that can be turned around.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenet is a principle or firmly held belief.

clue.text: Stragglers revealed in street lights

parts.note: rays are beams of light

explanation.surface: Lost animals spotted under the streetlamps.
explanation.definitionFit: Strays are those that wander off and lag behind, stragglers.

clue.text: Handy thing to take up or run

definitions.text: Handy thing to take up or run

parts.words: Handy thing to take up or run
parts.note: a glove for the hand, one you pick up when accepting a challenge or run between two lines of attackers

explanation.surface: Something useful that can be picked up or run with.
explanation.definitionFit: A gauntlet is a glove; one takes up the gauntlet or runs the gauntlet.

clue.text: Get a kick out of men, Joyce does!

indicators.note: does here means the phrase performs or contains the run of letters within it

explanation.surface: James Joyce's characters find pleasure in men.
explanation.definitionFit: To enjoy something is to get pleasure or a kick from it.

clue.text: Lead free

parts.note: a dog let off its leash is free of the lead, not petrol without the metal

explanation.surface: Petrol without the heavy metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Unleashed means released from a lead, set free.
